answer.rationale: Use a referral incentive aimed at established customers: it previously added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm, aligning with sustainable long-term revenue. Do not counter the competitor with broad promotional pricing: targeted discounts lifted acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, directly conflicting with the objective. Referral performance has not been established specifically as a churn-response mechanism for price-sensitive SMBs, so deploy as a measured standard experiment rather than assuming it will resolve all current churn pressure.
